notes: have I now any power at all: the fronted have is the interrogative particle's under rule 17, at all is the infinitive absolute's under rule 56, and any power is the finite yākōl's recasting with the supplied determiner joining it under rule 15. Rule 43's subtraction supports this, since dropping have leaves the verb its own power.
The bare infinitive dabbēr keeps the English to, no preposition morpheme standing to claim it.
